scams.name: Mount of Olives Pickpockets & Fake Sellers
scams.avoidance: Keep bags zipped and in front of you at all crowded overlooks Change camera lenses in a corner or inside the nearby cemetery Decline anything placed in your hands without asking

scams.name: Red String Blessing Scam
scams.avoidance: Firmly say 'no thank you' before they can touch your wrist Keep walking and avoid making eye contact with persistent string-sellers If a string is tied before you can stop it, you're not obligated to pay
scams.location: Stairs leading to the Western Wall from the Jewish Quarter

scams.name: Menu Without Prices Restaurant Trick
scams.avoidance: Never order from a menu without prices — leave if prices aren't displayed Explicitly confirm: 'I want the falafel in pita, how much is that exactly?' Check Google or TripAdvisor reviews for price complaints before sitting down
scams.location: Old City restaurants, particularly near Via Dolorosa and Jaffa Gate

scams.name: Jaffa Gate ATM & Money Exchange Scam
scams.avoidance: Avoid the ATMs directly at Jaffa Gate — use bank ATMs inside the city Use your bank card at a legitimate bank ATM and decline 'dynamic currency conversion' Exchange money at your hotel or a reputable bank before arriving at the Old City
scams.location: Jaffa Gate entrance to the Old City

scams.name: Aggressive Old City Souvenir Sellers
scams.avoidance: Keep walking with purpose — make eye contact only if you genuinely want to browse If something is placed in your hands, set it down firmly and walk on A polite but firm 'la shukran' (no thank you in Arabic) is respected
scams.location: Via Dolorosa and the Muslim Quarter markets

scams.name: Fake 'Closed' Attraction Redirect
scams.avoidance: Verify closure claims by walking to the attraction yourself Check official opening hours online before visiting each site Never follow a stranger who claims to know of a 'better' alternative
scams.location: Near the Church of the Holy Sepulchre and Dome of the Rock
